items.title: 10.3 Disproportionation reaction (ek hi element ka oxidize aur reduce hona) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.3, printed page 216.

blocks.title: Disproportionation reaction
blocks.text: Disproportionation reaction woh chemical reaction hai jis mein ek hi substance oxidizing agent bhi hota hai aur reducing agent bhi, aur nateeje mein do different (alag alag) products bante hain jin ki oxidation states different hoti hain.
Is qism ke reaction mein ek hi element ek saath (simultaneously) oxidize bhi hota hai aur reduce bhi.
Misal ke taur par hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) ka toot kar pani (H₂O) aur oxygen (O₂) banana disproportionation reaction hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein product H₂O₂⁻¹ chhapa hai, jo dobara hydrogen peroxide hai aur equation balance nahi hoti. Asal product pani hai jis mein oxygen −2 hai: 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂.

items: H₂O₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number = −1
H₂O mein oxygen ka oxidation number = −2 (oxygen −1 se −2 par reduce hui)
O₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number = 0 (oxygen −1 se 0 par oxidize hui)
Cl₂ mein chlorine atoms ka oxidation number = 0
NaCl mein chlorine ka oxidation number = −1 (Cl 0 se −1 par reduce hua)
NaClO₃ mein chlorine ka oxidation number = +5 (Cl 0 se +5 par oxidize hua)

blocks.text: Disproportionation reactions wahan ho sakti hain jahan ions ya molecules kai (multiple) oxidation states mein reh sakte hon.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehchan ka tareeqa: agar ek hi element reactant side par ek oxidation number rakhta ho aur product side par do alag oxidation numbers mein mile (ek zyada, ek kam), to reaction disproportionation hai. Cl₂ (0) se NaCl (−1) aur NaClO₃ (+5) iski achhi misal hai.

blocks.explanation: Haan. Copper +1 se ek taraf +2 (Cu²⁺, oxidation) aur doosri taraf 0 (Cu, reduction) par jata hai; ek hi element ek saath oxidize aur reduce hua.

items: Disproportionation: ek hi element ek saath oxidize aur reduce hota hai.
